S0122.reason: The friend can be convicted of burglary as an accomplice because he aided the young man's breaking and entering, even if he lacked intent to steal.

S0549.reason: Retention of fetal hemoglobin into adulthood typically causes no significant differences because its higher oxygen affinity is compensated by other physiological mechanisms.
